summary: Round 2 of Task 8 cleanly closes the round-1 critical and all six minor findings. The sleepWithDeadline clamp is correct: pre-check guards already-past deadlines, Math.min(durationMs, remainingMs) prevents wall-clock overshoot, and the post-check still fires deterministically at the budget boundary — so the SHORT_OVERALL_TIMEOUT=3s + retry_after=120 scenario now elapses ~3s instead of ~30s. Javadoc/comment scrubs (Decision 2 wording in TelegramRateLimitException, plaintext-token lifetime in TelegramSender, empty-response-body sentinel) and the small stylistic cleanups (Optional<Bot> inlined, unused java.util.Optional import dropped) are correct and introduce no regressions.

suggestions.benefit: Makes the invariant `0 ≤ remainingMs ≤ overallTimeout.toMillis()` explicit at the call site; one less mental step for the next reader.
